title: Under Grace or Under the Devil
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he warns against the dangers of a "hybrid grace" message that's sweeping the nation, and shows you how to live a life that's truly under God's covering of grace. In this eye-opening sermon, Pastor Chris exposes the lies of the world and encourages you to stay rooted in God's Word, where you'll find true peace, joy, and purpose. Don't miss this powerful message that will challenge you to re-examine your priorities and align your life with God's will.
